verdict.rationale: Signifyd markets a 'Chargeback Recovery' product and exposes API endpoints for recording Chargeback and Representment Outcome events, implying some automated dispute-handling capability, but the evidence pack gives no detail on how evidence (order, delivery, session data) is compiled or how submissions to issuers are automated end-to-end. missing for 10: documentation of automatic evidence compilation from delivery/session data, description of direct submission to issuers without manual steps, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the workflow.
